text:
Incident Bot: SEV2 — per-endpoint saturation detected (chat streaming conn exhaustion + embeddings queue growth). Paging @ben.
Nora Li: paging oncall. Chat streaming connections are maxed on frontends; client reconnect storms causing p50 latencies to spike 3x. Embeddings queue depth increasing, GPU queue latency > 4s. Affected: GlowPay (enterprise), many free-tier apps. Link: https://console.redwood/alerts/INC-181012
Ben Torres: on it. Quick ask: do we throttle by endpoint or by customer first? If we throttle by endpoint we protect system but may impact many customers.
Hannah Cho: recommend route-first throttles for immediate mitigation, then per-customer tweaks for big offenders. We have a helper in admin to set route->tier rules quickly.
Ben Torres: agreed. Plan: 1) apply immediate route-level caps for non-enterprise: chat rps=10, embeddings rps=6, rerank = disabled for free/standard; 2) emergency per-customer throttle for GlowPay to reduce their streaming concurrency to 5; 3) enable streaming-fallback to non-streaming for standard tier so clients get responses but with higher latency.
Nora Li: paste admin commands?
Ben Torres: commands — run from ops jump host:
```bash
# route caps for non-enterprise tiers
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/set -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","tiers":["free","standard"],"rps":10}'
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/set -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","tiers":["free","standard"],"rps":6}'
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/set -d '{"route":"/v1/rerank","tiers":["free","standard"],"enabled":false}'
# per-customer throttle (GlowPay)
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/customers/glowpay/actions -d '{"action":"set_concurrency","concurrency":5}'
# enable streaming-fallback for standard tier
curl -X PATCH https://admin.redwood/api/v1/config -d '{"feature":"streaming_fallback","tier":"standard","enabled":true}'
```
ops-rotation-bot: action recorded: quotas_patch by ben at 1810123512
Ben Torres: applied. Also reduced per-route token-burst to 400/min for free and 1200/min for standard to limit abusive bursts.
deploy-bot: model-rollout paused for chat-large at 1810123528 — paused due to incident gating.
Hannah Cho: enabling adaptive router throttling: if route /v1/chat p95 errors > 2% for 3m then reduce route rps by 50% for non-enterprise. This is temporary until runbook updated.
Ben Torres: set. Command: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/autothrottle -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","threshold_p95_errors":0.02,"window_s":180,"reduce_pct":0.5}'`
Nora Li: immediate impact: frontends freed up, connection count down ~45% in 2m, chat p50 latency down ~35%, embeddings queue depth halved. GlowPay still reporting degraded streams — they are at new concurrency 5.
Ben Torres: handoff to Hannah for monitoring and customer comms. I'll stay on rotation for escalation. Handoff note at 1810123560.
ops-rotation-bot: oncall handoff: ben -> hannah at 1810123560
Hannah Cho: taking over. Quick customer impact summary: GlowPay (enterprise) — degraded but workable, two free-tier partners saw failures (eduapi and quicknotes). Support ticket created for each. Support Bot: please notify affected customers of temporary throttles and remediation steps.
Support Bot: messages queued: GlowPay notified via support channel; tickets SUP-4501, SUP-4502, SUP-4503 created.
Nora Li: note — rerank disable caused one analytics job at GlowPay to fail; offering rerank bypass for enterprise customers via admin bypass token. Ben, can you add bypass?
Ben Torres: adding bypass for GlowPay rerank workflows: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/whitelist -d '{"customer":"glowpay","routes":["/v1/rerank"]}'` — done at 1810123599. ops-rotation-bot recorded.
Hannah Cho: 10m check-in: system metrics stable, chat errors reduced from 3.4% -> 0.9%, embeddings p95 down from 4.1s -> 1.2s. Free-tier experienced degraded throughput but fewer errors.
Nora Li: follow-up actions: document playbook steps and add per-route kill-switch snippet to runbook. Also add default per-customer per-route cap (e.g., 200 rps enterprise, 50 standard, 10 free) so this doesn't recur.
Ben Torres: I'll open RFC and PR for runbook updates. Also scheduling a post-incident review with SRE, product, and support.
Hannah Cho: rollback criteria: if p95 errors <1% and p95 latencies <1s for 20m, relax chat rps to 25 for standard and embeddings to 12, re-enable rerank for standard. I'll execute canary in 20m windows.
ops-rotation-bot: schedule note: canary rollback check at 1810124670 by hannah
Nora Li: closing notes — remember to update incident tracker with mitigation steps and attach logs. Incident Bot: please create ticket reference.
Incident Bot: INC-181012 created and linked to this thread.
